name: sherpa
description: Composable /frame, /shape, /implement skills — one per layer (macro, shape, build) — plus /review, /triage, and /restory skills for reviewing, triaging, and reconstructing story context, with adversarial review at every boundary. The user composes the workflow; opt-in /persist for state.

interface.shortDescription: Composable frame, shape, implement, review, triage, and restory layers
interface.longDescription: Adds opt-in Sherpa skills — /frame (scout, bind an intent), /shape (fan out directions, pick one, then plan the steps), /implement (build with per-step review), /review (adversarial code review), /triage (reason about and route unresolved PR review comments), /restory (reconstruct story context) — that the user composes into a workflow. Nothing persists unless you call /persist.
defaultPrompt: Use /frame to shape this fuzzy task.
Use /shape to fan out competing directions, pick one, and plan the steps.
Use /implement to build the approved plan.
Use /review for an adversarial code review.
Use /triage to reason about and route unresolved PR review comments.
